natural_language_statement:
On $\mathbb Z^2$, set $q=(1,0)$ and $r_n=(1,n+1)$ for $n\in\mathbb N$, and write $\det(a,b)=a_1b_2-a_2b_1$. For natural numbers $m\ne n$,

$$
\det(r_m,r_n)\ne0.
$$

This states pairwise independence of distinct rows in the explicit integer family. It does not assert a quantitative lower bound on normalized angular separation.
